notes: NAMING: same 'Find N5' name globally and in China; model codes CPH2671 (global) and 入网型号 PKH110 (China), both in aliases. Recorded dimensions and mass are the GLOBAL page values, which cover the two globally sold colours (Cosmic Black, Misty White). TRAP (c) — IMPORTANT DIVERGENCE: oppo.com/cn lists a third, thicker colour that the global page does not: 厚 展开：约 4.36 毫米（暮紫），约 4.21 毫米（玉白，缎黑）/ 折叠：约 9.35 毫米（暮紫），约 8.93 毫米（玉白，缎黑）, 重量 约 234 克（暮紫）约 229 克（玉白，缎黑） — i.e. the Dusk Purple (暮紫) variant is 9.35 mm folded / 4.36 mm unfolded and 234 g, versus 8.93 / 4.21 / 229 for Jade White (玉白) and Satin Black (缎黑). A CAD shell built to 8.93 mm will NOT fit the Dusk Purple unit. OPPO publishes a single folded thickness with no hinge-side vs non-hinge-side split, so depth_at_hinge is null; height is identical folded and open. All OPPO figures are prefixed 'about' / 约 — the manufacturer's own precision is kept. CREASE: OPPO names the hinge 'Titanium Alloy Flexion Hinge' (钛合金天穹铰链) and cites a 'TÜV Rheinland Minimised Crease Certification' / 无感折痕认证, but never states a teardrop/water-drop or U crease profile, so hinge.crease is null. free_stop is true on the FlexForm camera's documented multi-angle, hands-free use.
